requirements.admission: Only core Diagnostic admission/reasons/allowed_uses; L3 requires separate independent review/execution/OOS receipt
requirements.coverage: Independent visible calendar and point-in-time full-A universe denominator; no weekday or response-date denominator
requirements.freshness: Requested analysis date and actual cutoff; expected latest session requires certified calendar
requirements.historical_status: Point-in-time security lifecycle/ST/suspension and calendar; no current snapshot backfill
requirements.quality: Explicit per-record decision, finite scalars/cross-field identities; UNKNOWN is not accepted
requirements.reproduction: Pinned code/rules, batch, source versions, local evidence digest; snapshot digest is not source authenticity
requirements.semantics_units: Reviewed field mapping plus source definition/unit evidence; no cross-scope substitutions
requirements.source_authorization: Separate source, research/storage/automation/display/redistribution evidence; SDK MIT is not data permission
requirements.time: Actual observed/ingested/event/available timestamps <= as_of; collection is not historical first publication

sina_index.history: SDK history response; local retained sample <=550 completed dates; calendar denominator UNKNOWN

eastmoney_stock.history: Explicit 600000.SH, 2026-10-14..15, daily, unadjusted; not an identity/history certification

tencent_stock.history: Same explicit two-date sample; SDK start-year probe + one year page, not bounded server date filtering

legu_breadth.history: Current aggregate snapshot only; no point-in-time universe/partition/market amount

fields.open_interest/open_interest_change/volum: source contract counts, not A-share units

cffex_rankings.history: One IF date only; raw observation cannot replace certified calendar/time/version record

fields.market_amount_cny: CNY, full-A scope; finite nonnegative supported numeric scalar

all_a_turnover.history: No registered full-A historical turnover source; index/stock amount is not a substitute

cn_a_calendar.history: SH/SZ/BJ dated versions supported; no accepted live source configured

fields.exchange/session_date/opens_at/closes_at: CFFEX aware session window + visible calendar provenance

cffex_calendar.history: Not provided by existing SH/SZ/BJ SQLite calendar; cannot copy its sessions

security_identity.history: No live historical identity provider; sample instrument_id is an observation label only

fields.risk_status/effective_interval: explicit historical ST state; UNKNOWN is not normal

historical_st.history: Existing master risk_status remains unknown; current name cannot backfill ST

fields.instrument_id/trade_date/suspended: dated explicit status; missing bars != suspension

suspension.history: No certified daily status source; breadth suspension count also needs universe evidence

fields.delisting_date/available_at: first non-listed date + actual visible version time

delisting.history: No accepted historical lifecycle feed; null delisting date is not proof of continued listing

fear_greed.history: Existing six-factor formula only; incomplete factors => null full score, separate price proxy

evidence_boundary: Reviewed transport/parse/diagnostic metadata only; no raw prices/CSV/SDK frame; no source authorization, independent H, UI, OOS or production approval.

structured_feedback.implementation: completed candidate evidence bridge; independent H pending
